content.body: The MP34 was considered the "Rolls Royce of submachine guns," and was incredibly expensive to make due to the finest materials being used to manufacture it. It was in service from 1930-1970's and was used by many countries in different conflicts.
content.brief: WEAPON: Maschninepistole 34 (MP34) AMMO: 9x19mm Luger Parabellum MAGAZINE: 32 rounds MUZZLE VELOCITY: 410+/- m/s RATE OF FIRE: 600+/- rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: Luger Pistole 08 9 mm Automatic StiG 24 HE Grenades (4) NbHgn 39 Smoke Grenades (2) Combat Knife
content.title: Submachine Gunner (Maschinenpistolenschütze)
